fields.英文释义: To put something inside or between other things.
fields.搭配: insert A into B
fields.例句: Insert the card into the slot.

fields.英文释义: To connect a device to a socket, or fill a hole.
fields.搭配: plug in; plug a hole
fields.例句: Plug the cable into the socket.

fields.正文: 01 insert / plug insert ▷ 朗读 To put something inside or between other things. plug ▷ 朗读 To connect a device to a socket, or fill a hole. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 insert / plug · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 insert v. 插入；嵌入 强调把东西放进内部或间隙 insert A into B Insert the card into the slot. 将卡插入卡槽。 plug v. 插接；堵住 强调接通设备，或封住孔洞 plug in; plug a hole Plug the cable into the socket. 把电缆插入插座。 核心区别与用法 insert 强调插入某处；plug 强调插接或堵住，常用 plug A into B、plug in。 Insert the card. / Plug the charger into the socket. 插入卡片。／把充电器插进插座。 常用搭配与句型 insert A into B 把A插入B；plug a hole 堵洞；plug in a device 给设备接上电源；unplug 拔掉插头。 易错提醒 insert 注重放入动作，不保证接通电源。代词作 plug in 的宾语时常说 plug it in，不说 plug in it。 Insert the key into the lock, then plug the lamp in. 把钥匙插入锁中，然后给灯接上电源。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 要强调“放进去”用 insert；强调“插电或堵洞”用 plug。plug it in 中代词放在动词与 in 之间。

fields.英文释义: Costing a lot of money.
fields.搭配: an expensive watch
fields.例句: This watch is expensive.

fields.英文释义: So expensive that it prevents people from buying or doing something.
fields.搭配: prohibitive costs
fields.例句: The cost of repairs was prohibitive.

fields.正文: 02 expensive / prohibitive expensive ▷ 朗读 Costing a lot of money. prohibitive ▷ 朗读 So expensive that it prevents people from buying or doing something. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 expensive / prohibitive · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 expensive adj. 昂贵的 价格高，未必高到无法接受 an expensive watch This watch is expensive. 这块表很贵。 prohibitive adj. 高得令人却步的 费用成为购买或行动的障碍 prohibitive costs The cost of repairs was prohibitive. 修理费高得难以承受。 核心区别与用法 expensive 表示昂贵；prohibitive 表示费用高到足以阻止人购买或采取行动。 The hotel is expensive, but the flight cost is prohibitive. 酒店很贵，但机票费用更是高得难以承受。 常用搭配与句型 an expensive mistake 代价高昂的错误；prohibitive costs 高得令人却步的成本；prohibit sb from doing 禁止某人做。 易错提醒 expensive 可以只是“贵但买得起”；prohibitive 强调价格构成障碍。prohibitive 也可指具有禁止性质的，但费用义很常见。 The fees are high for me, but not prohibitive. 费用对我而言很贵，但还没有贵到负担不起。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 只是说价格高用 expensive；高到使人放弃用 prohibitive。后者不是单纯更高级的 expensive，而是多了一层阻碍行动的含义。

fields.英文释义: To impose a penalty or put someone at a disadvantage.
fields.搭配: penalize sb for sth
fields.例句: They penalized him for arriving late.
fields.例句译文: 他们因他迟到而处罚他。

fields.英文释义: To make someone suffer a penalty for doing something wrong.
fields.搭配: punish sb for doing
fields.例句: He was punished for cheating.

fields.正文: 03 penalize / punish penalize ▷ 朗读 To impose a penalty or put someone at a disadvantage. punish ▷ 朗读 To make someone suffer a penalty for doing something wrong. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 penalize / punish · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 penalize v. 处罚；使吃亏 按规则扣分、处罚，或使处于不利地位 penalize sb for sth They penalized him for arriving late. 他们因他迟到而处罚他。 punish v. 惩罚 对错误或不当行为施加惩罚，范围更广 punish sb for doing He was punished for cheating. 他因作弊受罚。 核心区别与用法 punish 泛指惩罚；penalize 常指按规则处罚、扣分，也指使处于不利地位。 Players are penalized for breaking the rules. 球员违规会受罚。 常用搭配与句型 penalize sb for sth 因某事处罚某人；punish sb for doing 因某行为惩罚某人；punishment 惩罚；penalty 处罚。 易错提醒 penalize 也指不公平地使某群体吃亏，不一定真的执行处罚；punish 可以来自家长、法院等，不只规则扣分。 The scoring system penalizes slow answers. 这套计分制度会使回答慢的人吃亏。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 规则扣分、处罚或制度让人吃亏时优先考虑 penalize；一般惩罚用 punish。两者都常接 for 表示处罚原因。

fields.英文释义: To fall, let something fall, or decrease in amount; a small amount of liquid.
fields.搭配: drop a glass; a drop in prices
fields.例句: I dropped my phone.

fields.英文释义: To fall or flow in small, separate drops.
fields.搭配: drip from; a dripping tap
fields.例句: Water dripped from the ceiling.

fields.正文: 04 drop / drip drop ▷ 朗读 To fall, let something fall, or decrease in amount; a small amount of liquid. drip ▷ 朗读 To fall or flow in small, separate drops. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 drop / drip · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 drop v./n. 落下；下降；一滴 可指一次掉落，也可指数量减少 drop a glass; a drop in prices I dropped my phone. 我把手机掉在地上了。 drip v./n. 滴落；滴水声 突出液体一滴一滴地流出 drip from; a dripping tap Water dripped from the ceiling. 水从天花板上滴下来。 核心区别与用法 drop 可表示落下、使落下或下降；drip 强调液体连续一滴滴落下。 Prices dropped. / The tap is dripping. 价格下降了。／水龙头在滴水。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 手机掉落、价格下跌用 drop；水龙头持续滴水用 drip。a drop of water 是一滴水；a drip 可指滴落声或滴漏。

fields.英文释义: Money left after costs are paid; to gain an advantage.
fields.搭配: make a profit; profit from
fields.例句: The shop made a profit.

fields.英文释义: Money paid for borrowing or saving money; a desire to know more.
fields.搭配: pay interest; interest in
fields.例句: The bank pays interest on savings.

fields.英文释义: An advantage or helpful effect; to help or gain from something.
fields.搭配: benefit from; be of benefit to
fields.例句: Exercise benefits your health.

fields.正文: 05 profit / interest / benefit profit ▷ 朗读 Money left after costs are paid; to gain an advantage. interest ▷ 朗读 Money paid for borrowing or saving money; a desire to know more. benefit ▷ 朗读 An advantage or helpful effect; to help or gain from something. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 profit / interest / benefit · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 profit n./v. 利润；获益 商业中常指收入扣去成本后的余额 make a profit; profit from The shop made a profit. 这家店盈利了。 interest n. 利息；兴趣 金融中是借贷资金的费用或收益；也指兴趣 pay interest; interest in The bank pays interest on savings. 银行支付储蓄利息。 benefit n./v. 好处；受益 对健康、学习、生活等产生的正面作用 benefit from; be of benefit to Exercise benefits your health. 锻炼有益健康。 核心区别与用法 profit 常指扣除成本后的利润；interest 在金融中指利息；benefit 指更广泛的好处。 The business made a profit; the bank paid interest. 企业赚了利润；银行支付了利息。 常用搭配与句型 make a profit 获利；pay interest on a loan 支付贷款利息；benefit from 从中受益；be of benefit to 对……有益。 易错提醒 interest 还指兴趣；interests 可指利益。benefit 可作动词，benefit sb 和 benefit from sth 方向不同。 Students benefit from the scheme, even though it makes no profit. 尽管这项计划不盈利，学生仍能从中受益。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 问“赚了多少”常用 profit；借贷产生的利息用 interest；广义好处用 benefit。benefit sb 是使某人受益，benefit from 是从某事中受益。

fields.英文释义: To turn around quickly; also to make thread or present a particular version of events.
fields.搭配: spin around; spin a story
fields.例句: The wheel was spinning fast.

fields.英文释义: To turn around a central point or axis; to have something as the main focus.
fields.搭配: revolve around; revolve on an axis
fields.例句: The discussion revolves around costs.

fields.英文释义: To turn around an axis or take turns in a regular order.
fields.搭配: rotate on an axis; rotate duties
fields.例句: Rotate the image clockwise.

fields.释义: n./v. 车轮；推着轮式物体移动；盘旋转向
fields.英文释义: A circular part that turns on an axle; to move something on wheels, or turn and move in a curve or circle.
fields.搭配: a bicycle wheel; wheel a suitcase; wheel around; birds wheeling overhead
fields.例句: Birds wheeled above the cliffs.

fields.正文: 06 spin / revolve / rotate / wheel spin ▷ 朗读 To turn around quickly; also to make thread or present a particular version of events. revolve ▷ 朗读 To turn around a central point or axis; to have something as the main focus. rotate ▷ 朗读 To turn around an axis or take turns in a regular order. wheel ▷ 朗读 A circular part that turns on an axle; to move something on wheels, or turn and move in a curve or circle. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 spin / revolve / rotate / wheel · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 spin v./n. 快速旋转 突出快速转动；也可指纺纱或编造说法 spin around; spin a story The wheel was spinning fast. 轮子正在快速旋转。 revolve v. 围绕转动 可绕中心运行，也可绕自身轴转动；并非只表示公转 revolve around; revolve on an axis The discussion revolves around costs. 讨论围绕成本展开。 rotate v. 旋转；轮换 绕轴转动或按顺序轮换，不必很快 rotate on an axis; rotate duties Rotate the image clockwise. 将图片顺时针旋转。 wheel n./v. 车轮；推着轮式物体移动；盘旋转向 名词指轮子；动词可指推着有轮子的物体走，或人、鸟等转身、盘旋移动，强调运动路径而非单纯绕轴自转 a bicycle wheel; wheel a suitcase; wheel around; birds wheeling overhead Birds wheeled above the cliffs. 鸟儿在悬崖上空盘旋。 wheel 作动词可指推着轮式物体移动或盘旋转向；revolve 也能绕自身轴转动，不能只按自转和公转二分。 核心区别与用法 spin 常强调快速自转；revolve 常指围绕中心转动；rotate 可指绕轴旋转或轮流。并非绝对互斥。 Earth rotates on its axis and revolves around the Sun. 地球自转，同时绕太阳公转。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 快速转动常用 spin，围绕中心运行常用 revolve，绕轴转动或轮换常用 rotate；这些用法有重叠。wheel 作名词是“轮子”，作动词则常描写推着轮式物体移动（wheel a suitcase），或盘旋、转身（birds wheel overhead / wheel around）。The wheel spins 是“轮子快速旋转”，第一个 wheel 是名词；不能把动词 wheel 机械替换成所有“自转”的说法。 revolve 也能描述绕轴自转，如 a revolving door；“revolve 只指公转、rotate 只指自转”不是普遍规则。

fields.英文释义: The gas form of a substance that can also be liquid or solid.
fields.搭配: water vapor; fuel vapor
fields.例句: Water vapor is invisible.

fields.英文释义: Water in its gas form, also used for the visible mist above hot water; to cook with steam.
fields.搭配: steam vegetables; a steam engine
fields.例句: Steam the vegetables for five minutes.

fields.正文: 07 vapor / steam vapor ▷ 朗读 The gas form of a substance that can also be liquid or solid. steam ▷ 朗读 Water in its gas form, also used for the visible mist above hot water; to cook with steam. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 vapor / steam · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 vapor n. 蒸气 物质处于气态的形式，不限于水；英式 vapour water vapor; fuel vapor Water vapor is invisible. 水蒸气是看不见的。 steam n./v. 水蒸气；蒸 特指水的蒸气；日常也称可见白雾为 steam steam vegetables; a steam engine Steam the vegetables for five minutes. 把蔬菜蒸五分钟。 核心区别与用法 vapor（英式 vapour）泛指蒸气；steam 特指水蒸气，日常也用来称呼热水上方可见的白雾。 The air contains water vapor. / Steam rose from the kettle. 空气中含有水蒸气。／水壶冒出蒸汽。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ vapor 范围比 steam 广。严格说可见白雾由细小水滴构成，但日常说 steam rose from the kettle 很自然；科学语境要分清物态。

fields.英文释义: Reasons supporting an opinion, or an angry disagreement.
fields.搭配: an argument for/against; have an argument
fields.例句: Her argument is supported by evidence.

fields.英文释义: A particular idea, opinion, or important detail in a discussion.
fields.搭配: make a point; the main point
fields.例句: You made a good point.
fields.例句译文: 你提出了一个很好的观点。

fields.英文释义: The process of developing and presenting reasons for a position.
fields.搭配: logical argumentation
fields.例句: The essay lacks clear argumentation.
fields.例句译文: 这篇文章缺少清晰的论证。

fields.正文: 08 argument / point / argumentation argument ▷ 朗读 Reasons supporting an opinion, or an angry disagreement. point ▷ 朗读 A particular idea, opinion, or important detail in a discussion. argumentation ▷ 朗读 The process of developing and presenting reasons for a position. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 argument / point / argumentation · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 argument n. 论据；论证；争吵 可以是一套理由，也可以是人与人争执 an argument for/against; have an argument Her argument is supported by evidence. 她的论证有证据支持。 point n. 要点；观点 讨论中的一个具体想法，不一定包含完整论证 make a point; the main point You made a good point. 你提出了一个很好的观点。 argumentation n. 论证过程或方法 正式、学术用语，强调组织理由的方式 logical argumentation The essay lacks clear argumentation. 这篇文章缺少清晰的论证。 核心区别与用法 point 是某个要点或观点；argument 是支持结论的一套理由，也可指争吵；argumentation 是展开论证的过程或方法。 Your point is clear, but your argument needs evidence. 你的观点很清楚，但论证需要证据。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 一个讨论要点是 point；支撑结论的理由可以是 argument；组织并展开论证的过程是 argumentation。argument 不一定是争吵，需看搭配。

fields.英文释义: A lack of order, or a condition affecting normal functioning.
fields.搭配: in disorder; a sleep disorder
fields.例句: The papers were in disorder.

fields.英文释义: Something that interrupts peace, order, or normal activity.
fields.搭配: cause a disturbance
fields.例句: The noise caused a disturbance.

fields.正文: 09 disorder / disturbance disorder ▷ 朗读 A lack of order, or a condition affecting normal functioning. disturbance ▷ 朗读 Something that interrupts peace, order, or normal activity. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 disorder / disturbance · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 disorder n. 混乱；失调；障碍 状态或某类功能异常，不必是一次事件 in disorder; a sleep disorder The papers were in disorder. 文件杂乱无章。 disturbance n. 打扰；干扰；骚乱 原有平静或正常活动受到扰动 cause a disturbance The noise caused a disturbance. 噪声造成了干扰。 核心区别与用法 disorder 指混乱、失调或某种障碍；disturbance 可指打扰、干扰或骚乱，也可指功能或状态的紊乱。 a sleep disorder / a noise disturbance 睡眠障碍／噪声干扰 怎么选？易错点在哪？ disorder 可指无序状态、疾病或功能障碍；disturbance 可指打扰事件，也可指功能或状态的紊乱，如 sleep disturbance。不能硬分成“长期状态”和“一次事件”。

fields.英文释义: To speak suddenly and loudly because of strong emotion.
fields.搭配: exclaim in surprise
fields.例句: “What a view!” she exclaimed.

fields.英文释义: To make a loud cry or speak very loudly.
fields.搭配: yell at; yell for help
fields.例句: He yelled for help.

fields.英文释义: To speak or call out in a loud voice.
fields.搭配: shout to/at sb
fields.例句: She shouted to us across the river.

fields.正文: 10 exclaim / yell / shout exclaim ▷ 朗读 To speak suddenly and loudly because of strong emotion. yell ▷ 朗读 To make a loud cry or speak very loudly. shout ▷ 朗读 To speak or call out in a loud voice. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 exclaim / yell / shout · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 exclaim v. 惊呼；大声说 强调情绪引发的突然表达，未必持续大喊 exclaim in surprise “What a view!” she exclaimed. “景色真美！”她惊叹道。 yell v./n. 大喊 常带强烈情绪，也可为让远处的人听见 yell at; yell for help He yelled for help. 他大声呼救。 shout v./n. 喊叫 提高音量，可传递信息、呼救或争吵 shout to/at sb She shouted to us across the river. 她隔着河向我们喊话。 核心区别与用法 exclaim 强调因情绪突然说出；yell 强调大声喊叫；shout 是较中性的大声喊。yell 和 shout 经常重叠。 “Amazing!” she exclaimed. / He shouted for help. “太棒了！”她惊呼。／他大声呼救。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 惊讶地脱口而出用 exclaim；提高音量用 shout/yell。shout at 常有对人怒喊的意味，shout to 常为让远处的人听见，但仍需看上下文。

fields.英文释义: A written record of speech, or an official record of academic results.
fields.搭配: a transcript of; an academic transcript
fields.例句: I read the interview transcript.

fields.英文释义: A person or thing with a similar role in another place or situation.
fields.搭配: one's counterpart in; a foreign counterpart
fields.例句: She met her French counterpart.
fields.例句译文: 她会见了法国的同职同行。

fields.正文: 11 transcript / counterpart transcript ▷ 朗读 A written record of speech, or an official record of academic results. counterpart ▷ 朗读 A person or thing with a similar role in another place or situation. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 transcript / counterpart · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 transcript n. 文字转录；成绩单 语音的文字记录，或课程成绩记录 a transcript of; an academic transcript I read the interview transcript. 我读了采访的文字稿。 counterpart n. 对应的人或物 在另一个组织或场景中承担相似职能者 one's counterpart in; a foreign counterpart She met her French counterpart. 她会见了法国的同职同行。 核心区别与用法 两词不近义：transcript 是文字转录或成绩单；counterpart 是另一组织或环境中职能相当的人或物。 an academic transcript / her French counterpart 一份成绩单／与她职位相当的法国同行 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 这两个词不是近义词。要找录音文字稿或成绩记录选 transcript；要描述“另一地区的同职人员或同类事物”选 counterpart。

fields.英文释义: To become stuck or crowded so that movement is difficult.
fields.搭配: a paper jam; a traffic jam
fields.例句: The paper jammed in the printer.

fields.英文释义: To prevent movement, access, or progress by putting something in the way.
fields.搭配: block the way; block access
fields.例句: A fallen tree blocked the road.

fields.正文: 12 jam / block jam ▷ 朗读 To become stuck or crowded so that movement is difficult. block ▷ 朗读 To prevent movement, access, or progress by putting something in the way. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 jam / block · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 jam v./n. 卡住；拥堵 突出物品挤在一起或机器无法运转 a paper jam; a traffic jam The paper jammed in the printer. 纸卡在打印机里了。 block v./n. 阻挡；障碍物 挡住通道、视线、进入或进展 block the way; block access A fallen tree blocked the road. 倒下的树挡住了道路。 核心区别与用法 jam 常指机器卡住或拥堵；block 强调阻挡通道或阻止进入。 The printer jammed. / A truck blocked the road. 打印机卡住了。／卡车堵住了路。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 打印机卡纸、交通拥堵常用 jam；道路、入口或视线被挡住常用 block。The door is jammed 侧重门卡死，The door is blocked 侧重门口被堵。

fields.英文释义: To officially choose someone for a role or set a time or place.
fields.搭配: appoint sb as/to; appoint a time
fields.例句: They appointed her as director.

fields.英文释义: To plan something or put things in a particular order.
fields.搭配: arrange to do; arrange for sb to do
fields.例句: We arranged for a taxi to collect her.
fields.例句译文: 我们安排出租车去接她。

fields.正文: 13 appoint / arrange appoint ▷ 朗读 To officially choose someone for a role or set a time or place. arrange ▷ 朗读 To plan something or put things in a particular order. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 appoint / arrange · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 appoint v. 任命；指定 赋予职位，或正式确定时间地点 appoint sb as/to; appoint a time They appointed her as director. 他们任命她为主任。 arrange v. 安排；筹备；整理 组织活动或把东西按顺序摆放 arrange to do; arrange for sb to do We arranged for a taxi to collect her. 我们安排出租车去接她。 核心区别与用法 appoint 常指任命，也可正式地指定时间地点；arrange 常指安排活动、筹备或整理。预约一般说 arrange a meeting 或 make an appointment。 They appointed her manager. / We arranged a meeting. 他们任命她为经理。／我们安排了会议。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 任命人到职位用 appoint；安排会议、交通和活动用 arrange。arrange for sb to do 很常见；不要把“预约”机械译为 appoint a meeting。

fields.英文释义: To notice an odor with your nose; an odor itself.
fields.搭配: smell of; smell good
fields.例句: The bread smells wonderful.

fields.英文释义: A particular smell, often a strong or unpleasant one.
fields.搭配: a strong odor; body odor
fields.例句: There was a strange odor in the room.
fields.例句译文: 房间里有股奇怪的气味。

fields.正文: 14 smell / odor smell ▷ 朗读 To notice an odor with your nose; an odor itself. odor ▷ 朗读 A particular smell, often a strong or unpleasant one. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 smell / odor · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 smell n./v. 气味；闻 通用词，可作感官动词，气味可好可坏 smell of; smell good The bread smells wonderful. 面包闻起来很香。 odor n. 气味 较正式，常见于描述强烈或不悦气味；英式 odour a strong odor; body odor There was a strange odor in the room. 房间里有股奇怪的气味。 核心区别与用法 smell 是常用的气味名词，也可作动词“闻”；odor（英式 odour）是名词，较正式，常用于明显或难闻的气味，但不一定难闻。 I can smell coffee. / a strong odor 我闻到咖啡味。／一股浓烈气味 怎么选？易错点在哪？ smell 可作名词也可作动词；odor 通常只作名词。感官系动词 smell 后常接形容词：smell good，而不是用 well 表示“闻起来很好”。

fields.英文释义: An organization for specialized work or study; to introduce a system or practice.
fields.搭配: a research institute; institute reforms
fields.例句: They instituted new safety checks.
fields.例句译文: 他们实行了新的安全检查。

fields.英文释义: An established organization, social system, or custom.
fields.搭配: a financial institution; the institution of marriage
fields.例句: Marriage is a social institution.

fields.正文: 15 institute / institution institute ▷ 朗读 An organization for specialized work or study; to introduce a system or practice. institution ▷ 朗读 An established organization, social system, or custom. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 institute / institution · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 institute n./v. 研究所；实行 名词常指专业研究教育机构；动词指建立或开始实施 a research institute; institute reforms They instituted new safety checks. 他们实行了新的安全检查。 institution n. 机构；制度；习俗 范围广，既可指组织，也可指长期社会制度 a financial institution; the institution of marriage Marriage is a social institution. 婚姻是一种社会制度。 核心区别与用法 institute 作名词多指研究或教育机构，作动词指建立、实行；institution 范围更广，涵盖机构、制度或社会习俗。 a research institute / a financial institution 研究所／金融机构 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 专业研究机构常叫 institute，但应尊重机构正式名称。institution 可描述银行、学校等组织，也能描述婚姻等制度，不能只理解为一个建筑。

fields.英文释义: Using analysis; often used in technical or academic terms.
fields.搭配: analytic philosophy; analytic geometry
fields.例句: She studies analytic philosophy.

fields.释义: adj. 分析的；善于分析的
fields.英文释义: Examining things carefully by considering their parts and relationships.
fields.搭配: analytical skills; an analytical approach
fields.例句: The task requires analytical skills.
fields.例句译文: 这项任务需要分析能力。

fields.正文: 16 analytic / analytical analytic ▷ 朗读 Using analysis; often used in technical or academic terms. analytical ▷ 朗读 Examining things carefully by considering their parts and relationships. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 analytic / analytical · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 analytic adj. 分析的 常见于学科术语，与 analytical 有大量重叠 analytic philosophy; analytic geometry She studies analytic philosophy. 她研究分析哲学。 analytical adj. 分析的；善于分析的 常形容思维、技能、方法和人 analytical skills; an analytical approach The task requires analytical skills. 这项任务需要分析能力。 核心区别与用法 都表示分析的，许多语境可互换。analytical 常见于能力、思维；analytic 常见于特定学术搭配。不要硬分成两个截然不同的意思。 analytical skills / analytic philosophy 分析能力／分析哲学 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 两词没有可靠的“理论与实践”二分。日常描述分析能力常用 analytical skills；学科术语按固定搭配记忆，两者许多场景可互换。

fields.英文释义: To enter or interfere where you are not welcome or invited.
fields.搭配: intrude on/upon
fields.例句: I don't want to intrude on your privacy.

fields.英文释义: To enter by force or spread into a place in large numbers.
fields.搭配: invade a country; invade privacy
fields.例句: Tourists invaded the quiet village.
fields.例句译文: 游客大量涌入这个安静的村庄。

fields.正文: 17 intrude / invade intrude ▷ 朗读 To enter or interfere where you are not welcome or invited. invade ▷ 朗读 To enter by force or spread into a place in large numbers. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 intrude / invade · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 intrude v. 闯入；打扰 未经邀请介入他人的时间、空间或事务 intrude on/upon I don't want to intrude on your privacy. 我不想侵犯你的隐私。 invade v. 入侵；侵占 更有强势进入或大量涌入的意味 invade a country; invade privacy Tourists invaded the quiet village. 游客大量涌入这个安静的村庄。 核心区别与用法 intrude 常指未经邀请闯入、打扰，常接 on/upon；invade 常指武力入侵或强势侵占，也可指侵犯隐私。 Sorry to intrude on your time. / invade a country 抱歉占用你的时间。／入侵一个国家 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 说“抱歉打扰”常用 intrude；军事入侵常用 invade。intrude on someone's privacy 与 invade someone's privacy 都成立，但前者有 on，后者直接接宾语。

fields.英文释义: The foot of an animal such as a cat or dog; to touch or scratch with it.
fields.搭配: a dog's paw; paw at
fields.例句: The dog put a paw on my knee.
fields.例句译文: 狗把一只爪掌放在我的膝上。

fields.英文释义: A sharp, curved animal nail or a pincer; to scratch or grip with claws.
fields.搭配: sharp claws; claw at
fields.例句: The cat scratched me with its claws.

fields.正文: 18 paw / claw paw ▷ 朗读 The foot of an animal such as a cat or dog; to touch or scratch with it. claw ▷ 朗读 A sharp, curved animal nail or a pincer; to scratch or grip with claws. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 paw / claw · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 paw n./v. 爪掌；用爪抓 猫狗等动物的整只爪掌，不只是尖端 a dog's paw; paw at The dog put a paw on my knee. 狗把一只爪掌放在我的膝上。 claw n./v. 尖爪；抓挠；螯 指尖锐弯曲的爪，也可指蟹等的螯 sharp claws; claw at The cat scratched me with its claws. 猫用尖爪抓了我。 核心区别与用法 paw 是猫狗等动物的爪掌；claw 是尖锐弯曲的爪，也可指螯。 The cat raised a paw and extended its claws. 猫抬起爪掌，伸出了尖爪。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ paw 是整只爪掌，claw 是尖爪；可以说 a paw with sharp claws。鸟类和蟹类通常不会把相应结构都称为 paw。

fields.英文释义: An opinion or remark; to express an opinion about something.
fields.搭配: comment on; make a comment
fields.例句: She commented on my report.
fields.例句译文: 她对我的报告发表了意见。

fields.英文释义: A spoken or written explanation or discussion of events.
fields.搭配: live commentary; commentary on
fields.例句: We listened to the live commentary.

fields.正文: 19 comment / commentary comment ▷ 朗读 An opinion or remark; to express an opinion about something. commentary ▷ 朗读 A spoken or written explanation or discussion of events. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 comment / commentary · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 comment n./v. 评论 一条意见，或发表意见的动作 comment on; make a comment She commented on my report. 她对我的报告发表了意见。 commentary n. 解说；评论 连贯的赛事解说、解释或系统评论 live commentary; commentary on We listened to the live commentary. 我们听了实况解说。 核心区别与用法 comment 是一条评论，也可作动词；commentary 是持续解说、系统评论或评论性文章。 make a comment / live football commentary 发表评论／足球实况解说 怎么选？易错点在哪？ comment 作动词常用 comment on sth，也可接 that 从句或直接引语：She commented that the room was cold. commentary 常指解说或较连贯的评论；不是简单按评论长短划分。

fields.英文释义: A hollow cylinder or a container shaped like one.
fields.搭配: a test tube; a tube of toothpaste
fields.例句: She bought a tube of toothpaste.

fields.英文释义: A tube used to carry liquid or gas; to transport something through pipes.
fields.搭配: a water pipe; pipe water to
fields.例句: Water flows through the pipe.

fields.正文: 20 tube / pipe tube ▷ 朗读 A hollow cylinder or a container shaped like one. pipe ▷ 朗读 A tube used to carry liquid or gas; to transport something through pipes. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 tube / pipe · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 tube n. 管；管状容器 可指试管、软膏管等多种管状物 a test tube; a tube of toothpaste She bought a tube of toothpaste. 她买了一管牙膏。 pipe n./v. 管道；用管输送 常用于输送气体或液体，也可指烟斗 a water pipe; pipe water to Water flows through the pipe. 水流经管道。 核心区别与用法 tube 泛指管状物，如试管、牙膏管；pipe 常指输送水气等的管道。不能只按软硬区分，实际用法有重叠。 a test tube / a water pipe 试管／水管 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 不要硬按材质软硬区分：test tube 也是硬的。试管、牙膏管等记 tube；供水、燃气管道常用 pipe，具体行业命名会有重叠。

fields.英文释义: Bags and cases used when travelling.
fields.搭配: a piece of luggage; hand luggage
fields.例句: We have three pieces of luggage.

fields.英文释义: Travel bags and cases; also emotional burdens from past experiences.
fields.搭配: baggage claim; emotional baggage
fields.例句: He carries a lot of emotional baggage.
fields.例句译文: 他背负着许多情感包袱。

fields.正文: 21 luggage / baggage luggage ▷ 朗读 Bags and cases used when travelling. baggage ▷ 朗读 Travel bags and cases; also emotional burdens from past experiences. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 luggage / baggage · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 luggage n. 行李（不可数） 出行时携带的箱包，常见于一般旅行语境 a piece of luggage; hand luggage We have three pieces of luggage. 我们有三件行李。 baggage n. 行李；包袱（不可数） 旅行义与 luggage 重叠，还可指情绪或经历负担 baggage claim; emotional baggage He carries a lot of emotional baggage. 他背负着许多情感包袱。 核心区别与用法 通常都指行李，都是不可数名词；baggage 还常用于 emotional baggage“情感包袱”。二者并非严格按英美划分。 two pieces of luggage / emotional baggage 两件行李／情感包袱 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 两词的行李义通常不可数：说 much luggage 或 two pieces of baggage，不说 two luggages。baggage 的抽象“情感包袱”义更常见。

fields.英文释义: Unhappy about someone else's advantages, or afraid of losing someone's affection.
fields.搭配: jealous of; a jealous partner
fields.例句: He was jealous of her success.

fields.英文释义: Wishing you had something that another person has.
fields.搭配: envious of
fields.例句: I'm envious of your free time.

fields.正文: 22 jealous / envious jealous ▷ 朗读 Unhappy about someone else's advantages, or afraid of losing someone's affection. envious ▷ 朗读 Wishing you had something that another person has. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 jealous / envious · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 jealous adj. 嫉妒的；吃醋的 既可嫉妒别人拥有的，也可担心关系被夺走 jealous of; a jealous partner He was jealous of her success. 他嫉妒她的成功。 envious adj. 羡慕的；嫉妒的 侧重想拥有别人已有的优点、东西或机会 envious of I'm envious of your free time. 我羡慕你的空闲时间。 核心区别与用法 envious 侧重羡慕别人拥有的东西；jealous 可表示嫉妒，也常指担心关系被第三人夺走。实际用法有重叠。 I'm envious of your free time. 我羡慕你的空闲时间。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 想拥有别人已有的东西常用 envious；担心伴侣关系受威胁常用 jealous。但 jealous 也广泛用于羡慕别人，不能硬说它只涉及三个人。

fields.英文释义: A substance that living things need to grow and stay healthy.
fields.搭配: essential nutrients; nutrient-rich
fields.例句: Food supplies essential nutrients.

fields.释义: n. 营养；营养摄取（不可数）
fields.英文释义: The process of taking in and using food, or the nourishment food provides.
fields.搭配: good nutrition; nutrition research
fields.例句: The course covers basic nutrition.
fields.例句译文: 这门课涉及基础营养知识。

fields.正文: 23 nutrient / nutrition nutrient ▷ 朗读 A substance that living things need to grow and stay healthy. nutrition ▷ 朗读 The process of taking in and using food, or the nourishment food provides. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 nutrient / nutrition · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 nutrient n. 营养素（可数） 具体能提供营养的物质 essential nutrients; nutrient-rich Food supplies essential nutrients. 食物提供必需营养素。 nutrition n. 营养；营养摄取（不可数） 整体营养过程、状况或研究领域 good nutrition; nutrition research The course covers basic nutrition. 这门课涉及基础营养知识。 核心区别与用法 nutrient 是可数的营养物质；nutrition 是不可数的营养、营养摄取或营养学。 Food provides nutrients. / Good nutrition matters. 食物提供营养素。／良好营养很重要。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 一种具体营养成分是 a nutrient；整体营养状态或营养摄取是 nutrition。形容词 nutritious 表示有营养的，nutritional 表示与营养有关的。

fields.英文释义: A curved or spiral shape; to form such a shape.
fields.搭配: curl up; curly hair
fields.例句: The edges of the paper curled.

fields.英文释义: A smoothly bending line or shape; to bend smoothly.
fields.搭配: a sharp curve; curve to the left
fields.例句: The path curves around the lake.

fields.正文: 24 curl / curve curl ▷ 朗读 A curved or spiral shape; to form such a shape. curve ▷ 朗读 A smoothly bending line or shape; to bend smoothly. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 curl / curve · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 curl n./v. 卷曲；卷发 形成卷圈、螺旋或卷起的边缘 curl up; curly hair The edges of the paper curled. 纸的边缘卷起来了。 curve n./v. 曲线；弯曲 平滑地改变方向，不必形成卷圈 a sharp curve; curve to the left The path curves around the lake. 小路绕湖弯行。 核心区别与用法 curl 强调卷曲、盘绕；curve 强调平滑弯曲或曲线，不一定卷成圈。 Her hair curls. / The road curves left. 她的头发卷曲。／道路向左弯。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 头发卷起或身体蜷成一团常用 curl；道路平滑转弯用 curve。curly 是卷曲的，curved 是弯曲的，不是同一种外形。

fields.英文释义: The contamination of the environment by harmful substances or effects.
fields.搭配: air pollution; reduce pollution
fields.例句: Air pollution has increased.

fields.英文释义: A substance that causes pollution.
fields.搭配: a major pollutant; release pollutants
fields.例句: The factory releases pollutants.

fields.正文: 25 pollution / pollutant pollution ▷ 朗读 The contamination of the environment by harmful substances or effects. pollutant ▷ 朗读 A substance that causes pollution. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 pollution / pollutant · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 pollution n. 污染（不可数） 环境被有害物质影响的现象或状态 air pollution; reduce pollution Air pollution has increased. 空气污染加重了。 pollutant n. 污染物（可数） 造成污染的具体物质或因素 a major pollutant; release pollutants The factory releases pollutants. 工厂排放污染物。 核心区别与用法 pollution 是污染这一状态或现象，通常不可数；pollutant 是造成污染的物质，通常可数。 Air pollution is caused by various pollutants. 空气污染由多种污染物造成。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 污染现象用 pollution；造成污染的物质用 pollutant。动词为 pollute，过去分词 polluted 常表示已被污染的。

fields.英文释义: Expressing refusal, opposition, or an unfavorable view or effect.
fields.搭配: a negative attitude; negative effects
fields.例句: She gave a negative answer.

fields.英文释义: Accepting what happens without taking an active role.
fields.搭配: a passive role; the passive voice
fields.例句: He remained a passive observer.

fields.正文: 26 negative / passive negative ▷ 朗读 Expressing refusal, opposition, or an unfavorable view or effect. passive ▷ 朗读 Accepting what happens without taking an active role. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 negative / passive · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 negative adj. 否定的；负面的 侧重观点、态度、影响或数值的性质 a negative attitude; negative effects She gave a negative answer. 她作了否定回答。 passive adj. 被动的 不主动行动、接受外力或安排；也指被动语态 a passive role; the passive voice He remained a passive observer. 他一直只是被动的旁观者。 核心区别与用法 negative 指否定的、负面的或悲观的；passive 指被动、不主动。一个人可以被动但并不悲观。 a negative attitude / a passive role 消极态度／被动角色 怎么选？易错点在哪？ negative 讨论正负、赞否或影响性质；passive 讨论是否主动。一个人可以态度乐观却行动被动，两者不自动对应。

fields.正文: 27 affect / effect affect ▷ 朗读 To influence or change someone or something. effect ▷ 朗读 A result or consequence; as a verb, to bring something about. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 affect / effect · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 affect v. 影响 直接描述某事改变或影响另一事物 affect sth/sb Stress affects sleep. 压力影响睡眠。 effect n. 效果；v. 促成 名词强调结果；正式动词强调使变化发生 have an effect on; effect change The policy had little effect. 这项政策作用不大。 核心区别与用法 最常见：affect 是动词“影响”；effect 是名词“影响、效果”，用 have an effect on。effect 也可作正式动词“促成”。 Sleep affects memory. / Sleep has an effect on memory. 睡眠影响记忆。 常用搭配与句型 affect performance 影响表现；have an effect on 对……有影响；take effect 生效；side effects 副作用；effect change 促成变化。 易错提醒 不要把 affect 直接用作普通名词“效果”；其名词义主要用于专业心理学语境。effective 是“有效的”，不是“受到影响的”。 Noise affects my concentration, but music has a calming effect on me. 噪声影响我的专注力，但音乐使我平静。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 常规表达用 affect + 宾语，或 have an effect on + 宾语。effect 作动词时是促成变化，不等于简单的“影响”；effect change 是常见搭配。

fields.正文: 28 smash / break / crash / crush smash ▷ 朗读 To break violently into pieces or hit with great force. break ▷ 朗读 To separate into pieces, stop functioning, or interrupt; a short rest. crash ▷ 朗读 To collide violently or suddenly stop working. crush ▷ 朗读 To press something so hard that it breaks or loses its shape. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 smash / break / crash / crush · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 smash v./n. 猛烈打碎或撞击 力度大，常造成破碎；也可夸张表达打破纪录 smash a window; smash into The ball smashed the window. 球打碎了窗户。 break v./n. 破坏；断裂；休息 最通用的损坏或断开，不限定方式 break a cup; break down I broke a cup. 我打破了一个杯子。 crash v./n. 碰撞；崩溃 车机猛烈撞击，或系统突然失灵 crash into; a plane crash The car crashed into a tree. 汽车撞上了一棵树。 crush v. 压碎；挤压 从外部施压使变形或碎裂 crush a can; crushed ice Crush the garlic before cooking. 烹饪前把蒜压碎。 核心区别与用法 break 泛指弄坏、断裂；smash 强调猛烈打碎；crash 强调碰撞或撞毁；crush 强调挤压、压碎。 The car crashed into a wall; the cans were crushed. 汽车撞上墙；罐子被压扁了。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 不强调方式时用 break；打得粉碎用 smash；撞上东西用 crash into；挤压变形用 crush。crash 也可表示电脑崩溃，与实体破碎不同。

fields.正文: 29 wreck / destroy / damage / ruin wreck ▷ 朗读 To damage something severely; something badly damaged or destroyed. destroy ▷ 朗读 To damage something so completely that it cannot be used or restored easily. damage ▷ 朗读 Harm that reduces value or usefulness; to cause such harm. ruin ▷ 朗读 To spoil something severely; destruction or the remains of a destroyed building. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 wreck / destroy / damage / ruin · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 wreck v./n. 严重毁坏；残骸 常用于车辆、建筑、计划的严重破坏 wreck a car; a shipwreck The collision wrecked the car. 碰撞使汽车严重损坏。 destroy v. 摧毁 破坏到无法使用或不复存在 destroy a building; destroy evidence The fire destroyed the warehouse. 大火烧毁了仓库。 damage v./n. 损害 不一定完全毁坏，程度可轻可重 damage equipment; damage to The rain damaged the books. 雨水损坏了书。 ruin v./n. 毁掉；废墟 使价值、体验、前途等严重受损 ruin a holiday; in ruins The argument ruined the evening. 争吵毁了这个夜晚。 核心区别与用法 damage 是损害，未必完全毁坏；destroy 指摧毁；wreck 强调严重破坏车辆等或毁掉计划；ruin 常指毁掉价值、前途、体验。wreckage 是残骸。 The rain ruined our picnic. / The storm damaged the roof. 雨毁了我们的野餐。／风暴损坏了屋顶。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ damage 不保证完全毁坏；destroy 通常强调摧毁。ruin 很适合坏掉的体验或前途，wreck 常用于严重毁坏车辆或计划，但这些不是绝对的程度等级。

fields.正文: 30 allege / claim allege ▷ 朗读 To say something is true, especially wrongdoing, without having proved it. claim ▷ 朗读 To state that something is true or demand something as your right. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 allege / claim · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 allege v. 指称；声称 常涉及未证实的不当行为，较正式 allege that; be alleged to They alleged that the figures were false. 他们指称这些数字是假的。 claim v./n. 声称；索取 主张某事为真，也可要求权利或领取物品 claim that; claim to do; claim compensation He claims to know the answer. 他声称知道答案。 核心区别与用法 claim 表示声称，范围广；allege 常用于尚未证实的不当或违法行为。用这两个词本身都不等于事情已经证实。 They alleged that he had stolen the money. 他们指称他偷了钱。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ allege 常提示涉及未获证实的指控；claim 范围更广，且有索取义。这两个动词都不自动证明陈述为真或为假，不能当作真假标签。

fields.正文: 31 delegate / deputy delegate ▷ 朗读 A representative; to give someone responsibility or authority to act. deputy ▷ 朗读 Someone who assists a leader and can act in their place. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 delegate / deputy · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 delegate n./v. 代表；委派 名词指代表；动词指把任务或权力交给别人 delegate tasks to; a conference delegate She delegated the task to me. 她把任务委派给我。 deputy n./adj. 副职；代理的 职位上的副手或获授权代行职务的人 deputy director; act as a deputy The deputy spoke in her absence. 她不在时由副手发言。 核心区别与用法 delegate 作名词是代表，作动词是授权、委派；deputy 是副职或获授权代行职务的人。 delegate a task / the deputy manager 委派任务／副经理 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 被派去参会的代表是 delegate；机构副手常是 deputy。delegate 作动词时可用 delegate a task to sb，名词与动词的重音/读音也有差异。

fields.正文: 32 gracious / kind gracious ▷ 朗读 Polite, kind, and generous, especially toward others in social situations. kind ▷ 朗读 Caring about others and wanting to help them. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 gracious / kind · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 gracious adj. 有礼而宽厚的 强调待人有风度，尤其面对输赢或地位差异 a gracious host; gracious in defeat The winner was gracious to her rivals. 获胜者对对手很有风度。 kind adj. 善良的；体贴的 泛指关心他人、愿意帮助，不要求正式礼仪 be kind to; a kind gesture It was kind of you to help. 你愿意帮忙，真是好心。 核心区别与用法 kind 泛指善良、体贴；gracious 常强调待人有礼、宽厚，尤其在地位优势或输赢情境中。 She was gracious in defeat. 她落败后仍表现得很有风度。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 一般善意用 kind；在胜负、接待或地位差异下表现礼貌宽厚可用 gracious。gracious 不等于 grateful：后者强调心怀感激。

fields.正文: 33 raise / rise / arise raise ▷ 朗读 To lift something, increase it, or bring a topic to attention. rise ▷ 朗读 To move upward or increase without a direct object. arise ▷ 朗读 To happen, appear, or come into existence. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 raise / rise / arise · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 raise v. 举起；提高；提出 及物：主语使别的东西上升或出现 raise prices; raise a question They raised the rent. 他们提高了租金。 rise v./n. 上升 不及物：主语自身上升或增加 rise to; rise by The rent rose sharply. 租金大幅上涨。 arise v. 出现；产生 不及物：抽象问题、机会或情况出现 arise from; difficulties arise New opportunities arose. 新的机会出现了。 核心区别与用法 raise 及物：使升高、提出、养育；rise 不及物：上升；arise 不及物：问题或机会出现。过去式依次为 raised、rose、arose。 They raised prices. / Prices rose. / A problem arose. 他们提价。／价格涨了。／出现了一个问题。 常用搭配与句型 raise–raised–raised；rise–rose–risen；arise–arose–arisen。raise a question 提出问题；rise by 10% 上涨10%；arise from 由……引起。 易错提醒 raise 后面通常要有宾语；rise 不直接接“被抬高的东西”。arise 常配 problem、difficulty、opportunity，不用来描述太阳升起。 A difficulty arose when the company raised its prices. 公司提价时出现了一个难题。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ raise 必须考虑“抬高了什么”；rise 的主语自身上升；arise 常用于问题或机会出现。过去分词依次为 raised、risen、arisen。

fields.正文: 34 cosmic / universal / astronomical / immense cosmic ▷ 朗读 Relating to the universe. universal ▷ 朗读 Applying to everyone or everything in a particular scope. astronomical ▷ 朗读 Relating to astronomy; also extremely large in amount. immense ▷ 朗读 Extremely large in size, amount, or degree. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 cosmic / universal / astronomical / immense · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 cosmic adj. 宇宙的 与整个宇宙有关，也可夸张表示极大 cosmic rays; cosmic scale Scientists study cosmic rays. 科学家研究宇宙射线。 universal adj. 普遍的；全体适用的 强调覆盖所有或广泛群体，不等于体积巨大 universal access; universal principles The rule is not universal. 这条规则并非普遍适用。 astronomical adj. 天文学的；数字巨大的 专业义与天体研究有关，夸张义常修饰费用数字 astronomical observations; astronomical costs The repairs cost an astronomical sum. 修理花了一笔天文数字般的钱。 immense adj. 极大的 可修饰规模、程度、数量等 immense pressure; immense value The discovery is of immense value. 这项发现价值巨大。 核心区别与用法 cosmic 指宇宙的，也可夸张地指极大的；universal 指普遍或全体适用的；astronomical 指天文学的，也指数字巨大；immense 直接强调巨大。 cosmic rays / universal rules / astronomical costs 宇宙射线／普遍规则／天文数字般的费用 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 宇宙相关选 cosmic；普遍适用选 universal；天文学相关或数字大得惊人选 astronomical；一般规模或程度巨大选 immense。

fields.正文: 43 accurate / precise accurate ▷ 朗读 Correct and close to the true facts or value. precise ▷ 朗读 Exact, detailed, and clearly expressed or measured. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 accurate / precise · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 accurate adj. 准确的 与事实或真实数值相符 accurate data; an accurate description The map is accurate. 这张地图很准确。 precise adj. 精确的；明确的 日常指准确具体、表达明确；测量语境可指重复结果接近，不应把精密度等同显示小数位数 precise instructions; to be precise Give me the precise address. 给我准确具体的地址。 核心区别与用法 accurate 强调与真实值相符；precise 强调精细、明确，测量中还可指重复结果彼此接近。可精密但不准确。 The instructions are precise, but the data are inaccurate. 指示很明确，但数据不准确。 常用搭配与句型 accurate information 准确信息；an accurate estimate 准确估计；precise instructions 明确细致的指示；to be precise 确切地说。 易错提醒 测量中 precise 可强调重复结果接近；日常语言中 precise 也常与准确义重叠，不必把所有语境都套进统计定义。 Repeated measurements are close to one another, but all are above the true value. 重复测量的结果彼此接近，但全部高于真实值。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ accurate 侧重正确贴合事实；precise 侧重细节清楚或测量一致。科学测量中的准确度与精密度有专门含义，日常用法则有重叠。

fields.正文: 44 argue / dispute / quarrel / debate argue ▷ 朗读 To give reasons for a view or disagree with someone verbally. dispute ▷ 朗读 To question whether something is true or valid; a disagreement. quarrel ▷ 朗读 An angry disagreement, often about a personal matter; to argue angrily. debate ▷ 朗读 To discuss opposing views, often in a structured way. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 argue / dispute / quarrel / debate · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 argue v. 争论；论证 既可争吵，也可提出理由支持观点 argue with; argue that She argues that the plan will work. 她论证说这个计划能奏效。 dispute v./n. 质疑；争议 对事实、权利、结果等提出异议 dispute a claim; a dispute over They disputed the figures. 他们质疑这些数字。 quarrel v./n. 争吵 较偏人际冲突、口角，常带情绪 quarrel with sb about sth They quarrelled about money. 他们为钱吵架。 debate v./n. 辩论；讨论 围绕议题比较观点、理由，也可指内心权衡 debate an issue; debate whether We debated whether to leave. 我们讨论是否离开。 核心区别与用法 argue 可指争吵或提出理由；dispute 强调对某个事实或权利有异议；quarrel 偏情绪化口角；debate 偏围绕议题交换论据。 They disputed the result and debated what to do next. 他们质疑结果，并讨论下一步该怎么办。 常用搭配与句型 argue with sb about sth 与某人争论某事；argue for/against 支持／反对并提出理由；dispute a claim 质疑主张；debate an issue 讨论议题。 易错提醒 argue that 常表示“提出论点认为”，并不意味着吵架。dispute 可直接接宾语，而 quarrel 常接 with/about。 She argued that the policy would save money. 她提出论点，认为这项政策会节约资金。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 要表达“论证认为”用 argue that，不要默认翻译成吵架。反对某个结果可用 dispute the result；围绕议题交换理由用 debate；人际口角常用 quarrel。

fields.正文: 45 wish / hope wish ▷ 朗读 To want something, often something unreal or unlikely; to express a good desire for someone. hope ▷ 朗读 To want something to happen and think it may be possible. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 wish / hope · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 wish v./n. 希望；祝愿 可表达与事实不符的愿望、遗憾；wish to do 较正式 wish I knew; wish sb luck I wish I had more time. 我真希望有更多时间。 hope v./n. 希望 希望某事发生，通常认为有可能 hope to do; hope that I hope to see you soon. 我希望很快见到你。 核心区别与用法 hope 常用于认为有可能的愿望：hope to do、hope that；wish 可表达遗憾或不现实愿望，也用于祝愿。wish to do 是正式的“想要”。 I hope you pass. / I wish I knew the answer. 希望你通过。／真希望我知道答案。 常用搭配与句型 hope to do 希望做；hope that… 希望……；wish sb luck 祝好运；wish + 过去式 表示与现在事实相反的愿望；wish + had done 表示对过去遗憾。 易错提醒 I wish I knew 表示现在不知道；I wish I had known 表示当时不知道。通常不说 hope sb to do，应说 hope that sb will do。 I hope I pass tomorrow. / I wish I had studied harder yesterday. 我希望明天通过。／我真希望昨天学得更努力些。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 希望未来可能实现的事常用 hope；遗憾现在事实常用 wish + 过去式；遗憾过去常用 wish + had done。I wish to speak 是正式的“我想发言”，并不表示不可能。

fields.正文: 46 exchange / swap exchange ▷ 朗读 To give and receive things, ideas, or information in return. swap ▷ 朗读 To exchange one thing for another, often directly between two people. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 exchange / swap · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 exchange v./n. 交换；交流 范围广，包括意见、货币、信息和物品 exchange A for B; exchange ideas We exchanged email addresses. 我们交换了邮箱地址。 swap v./n. 互换 更口语，常指双方直接交换两件东西或角色 swap A for B; swap seats Can we swap seats? 我们可以换座位吗？ 核心区别与用法 exchange 较广且较正式，可指交换货币、意见等；swap 较口语，常指互换两件东西。 exchange ideas / swap seats 交流想法／交换座位 怎么选？易错点在哪？ exchange 覆盖意见、货币、礼物等多种交流；swap 更常见于日常互换。exchange/swap A for B 表示拿A换B；与人交换则常用 with。

fields.英文释义: Careful about other people's feelings and needs.
fields.搭配: considerate of/towards
fields.例句: Please be considerate of others.

fields.英文释义: Showing care for others or thinking carefully about something.
fields.搭配: a thoughtful gift; thoughtful analysis
fields.例句: That was a thoughtful gift.

fields.正文: 47 considerate / thoughtful considerate ▷ 朗读 Careful about other people's feelings and needs. thoughtful ▷ 朗读 Showing care for others or thinking carefully about something. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 considerate / thoughtful · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 considerate adj. 体谅人的 考虑别人感受，避免造成不便 considerate of/towards Please be considerate of others. 请体谅他人。 thoughtful adj. 体贴的；深思的 可指贴心行为，也可指认真思考的状态或成果 a thoughtful gift; thoughtful analysis That was a thoughtful gift. 那是一份贴心的礼物。 核心区别与用法 considerate 侧重顾及别人、不添麻烦；thoughtful 可指体贴，也可指深思的。 It was thoughtful of you to bring food. 你带来食物真体贴。 常用搭配与句型 be considerate of/towards others 体谅别人；It is thoughtful of you to do 你做某事很体贴；a thoughtful expression 若有所思的神情。 易错提醒 thoughtful 不总是“体贴的”；a thoughtful analysis 表示经过认真思考的分析。considerable 则是“相当大的”，不要与 considerate 混淆。 It was considerate of him to keep his voice down. 他压低声音，很为别人着想。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ considerate 侧重顾及别人；thoughtful 既可贴心也可深思。注意 considerate 与 considerable（相当大的）拼写相似，词义却不同。

fields.英文释义: To make something shorter or more concentrated, or change gas into liquid.
fields.搭配: condense into; condense a report
fields.例句: Condense the report into one page.

fields.英文释义: To press into less space or reduce the size of data.
fields.搭配: compress a file; compress air
fields.例句: Compress the file before sending it.

fields.正文: 48 condense / compress condense ▷ 朗读 To make something shorter or more concentrated, or change gas into liquid. compress ▷ 朗读 To press into less space or reduce the size of data. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 condense / compress · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 condense v. 凝结；浓缩；缩写 气体变液体，或提炼内容使紧凑 condense into; condense a report Condense the report into one page. 把报告浓缩为一页。 compress v. 压缩 通过压力、编码等减少体积或占用空间 compress a file; compress air Compress the file before sending it. 发送前先压缩文件。 核心区别与用法 condense 指浓缩、缩写，也指气体凝结；compress 指压缩体积、文件或把内容挤进更短空间。 Water vapor condenses. / Compress the file. 水蒸气凝结。／压缩文件。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 气体凝结用 condense；压缩文件、气体体积用 compress。缩短文章时两者都可能成立：condense 更突出浓缩要点，compress 更突出压入更短篇幅。

fields.英文释义: A reason for a particular action.
fields.搭配: a motive for; an ulterior motive
fields.例句: Her motive was to help others.

fields.英文释义: The desire or drive to act, or the reasons behind an action.
fields.搭配: motivation to do; lack motivation
fields.例句: I lack the motivation to study.

fields.正文: 49 motive / motivation motive ▷ 朗读 A reason for a particular action. motivation ▷ 朗读 The desire or drive to act, or the reasons behind an action. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 motive / motivation · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 motive n. 动机 具体行动背后的原因，调查语境常见但未必负面 a motive for; an ulterior motive Her motive was to help others. 她的动机是帮助别人。 motivation n. 动力；动机 既可指行为原因，也常指行动积极性 motivation to do; lack motivation I lack the motivation to study. 我缺乏学习动力。 核心区别与用法 motive 常指某次行为背后的具体动机，尤其调查语境；motivation 指动力、积极性或促使行为的原因，可与 motive 重叠。 a motive for the crime / motivation to study 犯罪动机／学习动力 常用搭配与句型 a motive for doing 做某事的动机；an ulterior motive 隐藏的动机；motivation to learn 学习动力；lack motivation 缺乏积极性。 易错提醒 motive 常关注“为什么做了这件事”；motivation 也可问原因，但在学习、工作中常关注“有没有动力坚持”。motive 不必一定是坏的。 Her motive was to help, but she lacked the motivation to continue. 她的动机是帮助别人，但缺乏继续下去的动力。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 问一次行为的具体理由用 motive 很自然；问学习积极性用 motivation 更自然。motivation 也可指行为动机，不能把二者完全割裂。

fields.英文释义: Directly connected to the matter being considered.
fields.搭配: relevant to; relevant experience
fields.例句: Please give relevant examples.

fields.释义: adj. 有联系的；有亲属关系的
fields.英文释义: Connected in some way, or belonging to the same family.
fields.搭配: related to; closely related
fields.例句: Are these two events related?

fields.正文: 50 relevant / related relevant ▷ 朗读 Directly connected to the matter being considered. related ▷ 朗读 Connected in some way, or belonging to the same family. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 relevant / related · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 relevant adj. 相关且切题的 与当前问题、目标或任务有关 relevant to; relevant experience Please give relevant examples. 请给出切题的例子。 related adj. 有联系的；有亲属关系的 只说明有联系，未必有助于当前问题 related to; closely related Are these two events related? 这两件事有关联吗？ 核心区别与用法 related 只表示有联系，也可指有亲属关系；relevant 表示与当前问题直接相关、有用。常用 related to、relevant to。 The article is related to economics but not relevant to this question. 文章与经济学有关，但与这道题不相关。 常用搭配与句型 be relevant to the discussion 与讨论有关；relevant experience 相关经验；be related to 与……有关；closely related 密切相关。 易错提醒 related 强调存在联系；relevant 还强调对当前目的有关系或价值。两者常接 to，不能默认改为 with。 These two subjects are related, but only one is relevant to my essay. 这两个主题有关联，但只有一个与我的论文相关。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ “有关联”不保证“切题”。related to 表联系，relevant to 表与当前目标相关；寻找写作论据时更应检查其是否 relevant。

fields.英文释义: To make something happen sooner or act without delay.
fields.搭配: hasten recovery; hasten to do
fields.例句: She hastened to explain.

fields.英文释义: To repeatedly trouble, pressure, or attack someone.
fields.搭配: harry sb; be harried by
fields.例句: Reporters harried him with questions.
fields.例句译文: 记者不断用问题纠缠他。

fields.正文: 51 hasten / harry hasten ▷ 朗读 To make something happen sooner or act without delay. harry ▷ 朗读 To repeatedly trouble, pressure, or attack someone. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 hasten / harry · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 hasten v. 加快；赶紧做 使过程更快，或急忙采取行动；较正式 hasten recovery; hasten to do She hastened to explain. 她赶紧作出解释。 harry v. 不断骚扰；纠缠 反复攻击、逼迫或打扰；不是 hurry 的变体 harry sb; be harried by Reporters harried him with questions. 记者不断用问题纠缠他。 核心区别与用法 hasten 指加快、赶紧做；harry 指不断骚扰、逼迫。不能把 harry 当作 hurry“匆忙”的同义拼写。 hasten recovery / be harried by reporters 加快康复／被记者不断纠缠 怎么选？易错点在哪？ hasten 与 harry 不是一组可随便互换的同义词。若想表达“赶快”，常见词其实是 hurry；harry 则带有纠缠、反复施压的意味。

fields.英文释义: Because of a particular cause or reason.
fields.搭配: owing to rain; owing to a delay
fields.例句: The match stopped owing to rain.

fields.英文释义: Because of or caused by something.
fields.搭配: due to a fault; be due to do
fields.例句: The delay was due to a fault.

fields.正文: 52 owing to / due to owing to ▷ 朗读 Because of a particular cause or reason. due to ▷ 朗读 Because of or caused by something. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 owing to / due to · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 owing to 介词短语：因为 后接名词性成分，交代原因；较正式 owing to rain; owing to a delay The match stopped owing to rain. 比赛因雨停止。 due to 介词性短语：由于 现代英语中原因义与 owing to 广泛重叠 due to a fault; be due to do The delay was due to a fault. 延误是由故障造成的。 核心区别与用法 都可表示因为，后接名词或名词短语；现代英语中用法大量重叠。be due to do 则表示预计做某事。 The game was cancelled owing to rain. 比赛因雨取消。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 原因义后面接名词或动名词，不直接接完整句子；完整原因从句可用 because。be due to arrive 中 to 是不定式标记，意思是预计到达，不是“因为到达”。

fields.英文释义: To repeat someone's exact words or state a price.
fields.搭配: quote from; quote a price
fields.例句: She quoted a line from the poem.

fields.英文释义: To mention a source, example, or fact as support.
fields.搭配: cite a source; cite evidence
fields.例句: He cited several studies.

fields.正文: 53 quote / cite quote ▷ 朗读 To repeat someone's exact words or state a price. cite ▷ 朗读 To mention a source, example, or fact as support. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 quote / cite · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 quote v./n. 引用原话；报价 强调复现原文，也可指提供价格 quote from; quote a price She quoted a line from the poem. 她引用了诗中的一行。 cite v. 援引；列举 指出来源、例证或理由，不必逐字复制 cite a source; cite evidence He cited several studies. 他援引了几项研究。 核心区别与用法 quote 强调直接引用原话；cite 强调援引来源、证据或例子，不一定逐字引用。 She quoted a sentence and cited the author. 她引用了一句话，并注明作者。 常用搭配与句型 quote sb as saying 引述某人说；quote from a book 引用书中原话；cite a source 援引来源；cite sth as evidence 以某事为证。 易错提醒 quote 还有“报价”义；cite 可援引数据、案例、理由，不必复述原话。引用原话和标明来源是两个动作，可同时发生。 He cited the study without quoting any of its sentences. 他援引了这项研究，但没有逐字引用其中的句子。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 直接复制原话通常是 quote；交代依据来源通常是 cite。可以 cite 一项研究而完全不 quote 其原句，也可以同时做这两件事。

fields.英文释义: To assign resources to a particular person or purpose.
fields.搭配: allocate sth to sb; allocate time for
fields.例句: We allocated an hour to discussion.
fields.例句译文: 我们安排了一小时讨论。

fields.英文释义: To give things out or spread them over an area.
fields.搭配: distribute sth to; evenly distributed
fields.例句: They distributed food to the villagers.

fields.正文: 54 allocate / distribute allocate ▷ 朗读 To assign resources to a particular person or purpose. distribute ▷ 朗读 To give things out or spread them over an area. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 allocate / distribute · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 allocate v. 分配；划拨 按计划决定资源归属或用途 allocate sth to sb; allocate time for We allocated an hour to discussion. 我们安排了一小时讨论。 distribute v. 分发；分布 把东西送到各处，或呈某种空间分布 distribute sth to; evenly distributed They distributed food to the villagers. 他们向村民分发食物。 核心区别与用法 allocate 强调分配份额、预算或用途；distribute 强调把东西分发或散布到各处。 allocate funds / distribute leaflets 分配资金／分发传单 常用搭配与句型 allocate time to a task 给任务分配时间；allocate funds for research 拨款用于研究；distribute sth to people 向人们分发；distribute evenly 均匀分布。 易错提醒 allocate 关注资源分给谁或用于什么；distribute 关注实际分发或空间分布。两者可能描述同一过程的不同阶段。 We allocated funds to each class, then distributed the books. 我们给每个班分配了资金，然后分发了图书。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 预算怎么分、时间留给谁，常用 allocate；东西具体发到各处，常用 distribute。分配可能先于分发，但两词也会在资源分配语境中重叠。

fields.英文释义: To express strong disagreement or objection; an act of opposition.
fields.搭配: protest against; protest that
fields.例句: Students protested against the change.

fields.释义: v. 公然违抗；使无法解释
fields.英文释义: To openly refuse to obey, or resist explanation or expectation.
fields.搭配: defy an order; defy explanation
fields.例句: He defied the order to leave.

fields.正文: 55 protest / defy protest ▷ 朗读 To express strong disagreement or objection; an act of opposition. defy ▷ 朗读 To openly refuse to obey, or resist explanation or expectation. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 protest / defy · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 protest v./n. 抗议；坚决表示 表达反对；也可指坚称某事 protest against; protest that Students protested against the change. 学生抗议这项变化。 defy v. 公然违抗；使无法解释 不服从命令或挑战预期、解释能力 defy an order; defy explanation He defied the order to leave. 他违抗离开的命令。 核心区别与用法 protest 强调表达反对；defy 强调公然违抗、不服从，也可指难以解释。抗议不一定意味着违抗。 protest against a policy / defy an order 抗议政策／违抗命令 怎么选？易错点在哪？ protest 侧重表达反对，不保证不服从；defy 侧重违抗。defy explanation 意为难以解释，而不是“抗议解释”。

fields.英文释义: To find the position of something or establish it in a place.
fields.搭配: locate a fault; be located in
fields.例句: We finally located the missing file.
fields.例句译文: 我们终于找到了丢失的文件。

fields.英文释义: To place something in a location or a particular context.
fields.搭配: be situated near; situate sth within
fields.例句: The hotel is situated near the river.

fields.正文: 56 locate / situate locate ▷ 朗读 To find the position of something or establish it in a place. situate ▷ 朗读 To place something in a location or a particular context. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 locate / situate · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 locate v. 找到位置；把……设于 可强调寻找定位，也可描述选址 locate a fault; be located in We finally located the missing file. 我们终于找到了丢失的文件。 situate v. 使位于；置于背景 常用被动描述地点，也可放进概念背景 be situated near; situate sth within The hotel is situated near the river. 酒店坐落在河边。 核心区别与用法 locate 可指找出位置或把某物设在某地；situate 偏把某物放在某个位置或背景下。描述坐落常用 be located/situated in。 The hotel is situated near the station. 酒店坐落在车站附近。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 主动找出物品位置常用 locate，不用 situate 代替。描述建筑坐落位置，两者的被动结构 be located/situated in/near 都很常见。

fields.英文释义: Being in a place or existing there; also a noticeable personal quality.
fields.搭配: in the presence of; a strong presence
fields.例句: Your presence means a lot to me.
fields.例句译文: 你能在场对我意义重大。

fields.英文释义: The state of being real or alive, or a way of living.
fields.搭配: come into existence; the existence of
fields.例句: They questioned the existence of the island.
fields.例句译文: 他们怀疑这座岛是否存在。

fields.英文释义: The state of not being present or of something being missing.
fields.搭配: in the absence of; absence from
fields.例句: We worked in her absence.
fields.例句译文: 她不在时我们继续工作。

fields.正文: 57 presence / existence / absence presence ▷ 朗读 Being in a place or existing there; also a noticeable personal quality. existence ▷ 朗读 The state of being real or alive, or a way of living. absence ▷ 朗读 The state of not being present or of something being missing. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 presence / existence / absence · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 presence n. 在场；存在；气场 强调某人某物在特定地点或情境中出现 in the presence of; a strong presence Your presence means a lot to me. 你能在场对我意义重大。 existence n. 存在；生活 强调存在与否或生存状态 come into existence; the existence of They questioned the existence of the island. 他们怀疑这座岛是否存在。 absence n. 缺席；缺乏 某人没在场，或某物不存在于当前情境 in the absence of; absence from We worked in her absence. 她不在时我们继续工作。 核心区别与用法 presence 强调在场、存在于某处，也可指气场；existence 强调是否存在；absence 指缺席或缺乏。present/absent 是对应形容词。 Her presence was reassuring. / the existence of life 她在场令人安心。／生命的存在 怎么选？易错点在哪？ existence 问是否存在；presence 问是否在某处或当前情境中出现；absence 是未在场或缺乏。absence from class 指缺课，absence of evidence 指缺乏证据。

fields.英文释义: Serious danger.
fields.搭配: in peril; at one's peril
fields.例句: The ship was in peril.

fields.英文释义: The possibility of harm or a situation that may cause it.
fields.搭配: in danger; danger of
fields.例句: The building is in danger of collapse.

fields.英文释义: The possibility of an unwanted outcome; to expose someone or something to it.
fields.搭配: risk of; risk doing
fields.例句: There is a risk of delay.

fields.英文释义: A source of potential harm or danger.
fields.搭配: a fire hazard; a safety hazard
fields.例句: Loose cables are a tripping hazard.
fields.例句译文: 松散的电缆有绊倒人的危险。

fields.正文: 58 peril / danger / risk / hazard peril ▷ 朗读 Serious danger. danger ▷ 朗读 The possibility of harm or a situation that may cause it. risk ▷ 朗读 The possibility of an unwanted outcome; to expose someone or something to it. hazard ▷ 朗读 A source of potential harm or danger. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 peril / danger / risk / hazard · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 peril n. 严重危险 较正式或文学化，强调处境凶险 in peril; at one's peril The ship was in peril. 这艘船处于险境。 danger n. 危险 通用的危险状态或可能造成伤害的事物 in danger; danger of The building is in danger of collapse. 大楼有倒塌危险。 risk n./v. 风险；冒险 不良结果出现的可能性，或承担这种可能性 risk of; risk doing There is a risk of delay. 存在延误的风险。 hazard n. 危险源；隐患 容易导致伤害或事故的因素 a fire hazard; a safety hazard Loose cables are a tripping hazard. 松散的电缆有绊倒人的危险。 核心区别与用法 danger 泛指危险；peril 较正式，常指严重危险；risk 指不良结果的可能性或风险；hazard 常指具体危险源。 Ice is a hazard that increases the risk of falling. 冰是增加跌倒风险的危险因素。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 危险源可用 hazard，不良结果概率用 risk，危险处境常用 danger，文学或正式的险境可用 peril。真实语境会有重叠，这不是四个互斥类别。

fields.正文: 59 contract / infect contract ▷ 朗读 A binding agreement; as a verb, to make an agreement, become smaller, or catch an illness. infect ▷ 朗读 To cause a person or organism to acquire an infection. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 contract / infect · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 contract v. 染上；收缩；n. 合同 疾病义中，主语是患病者；词义依语境判断 contract a disease; sign a contract He contracted an infection abroad. 他在国外受到感染。 infect v. 使感染 主语或来源导致别人感染；也可用于情绪感染 infect sb with; be infected with The virus infected many people. 病毒感染了许多人。 核心区别与用法 疾病义中：某人 contract a disease 表示患上疾病；病原体或患者 infect someone 表示使别人感染。contract 还有合同、收缩等其他义。 He contracted flu. / The virus infected many people. 他患了流感。／病毒感染了很多人。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 病人 contract a disease；病原体 infect a person。被动可用 be infected with。注意 contract 名词“合同”和动词“染病”的重音不同。

fields.正文: 60 bill / receipt / invoice / check bill ▷ 朗读 A statement of money owed for goods or services. receipt ▷ 朗读 A record confirming payment; also the act of receiving something. invoice ▷ 朗读 A detailed business bill requesting payment; to issue such a bill. check ▷ 朗读 To examine; also a written bank payment order or, in American English, a restaurant bill. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 bill / receipt / invoice / check · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 bill n. 账单 常指要求支付的费用清单，另有法案等义 pay a bill; an electricity bill Could we have the bill? 请给我们账单好吗？ receipt n. 收据；收到 收据义强调已支付的凭据；收到义较正式 keep a receipt; on receipt of Keep the receipt as proof of payment. 保留收据作为付款凭证。 invoice n./v. 商业账单；开账单 列出货物或服务与费用的商业单据 issue an invoice; invoice sb for The supplier sent an invoice. 供应商发来了账单。 check n./v. 支票；账单；检查 美式可指餐馆账单；支票英式拼作 cheque pay by check; check the total Can we have separate checks? 我们可以分开结账吗？ 核心区别与用法 bill 是待付账单；receipt 是付款后收据；invoice 是列明货物或服务及金额的商业单据，不自动等于税务发票；check 在美式餐馆可指账单，也指支票。 Could I have the bill? / Please keep the receipt. 请给我账单。／请保留收据。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 要付钱的账单常是 bill；已付款凭证常是 receipt；商业明细账单常是 invoice。invoice 不自动等于某地税务意义的发票，check 的账单义主要见于美式餐馆。

fields.正文: 61 gear / equipment / device gear ▷ 朗读 Equipment for an activity, or a toothed wheel or speed setting in a machine. equipment ▷ 朗读 The tools or items needed for an activity. device ▷ 朗读 An object or piece of equipment designed for a particular purpose. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 gear / equipment / device · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 gear n. 装备；齿轮；挡位 装备义偏日常，常是某活动的一套用品 camping gear; change gear Pack your swimming gear. 带好你的游泳装备。 equipment n. 设备（不可数） 某用途所需工具设备的总称 a piece of equipment; safety equipment The laboratory needs new equipment. 实验室需要新设备。 device n. 装置（可数） 为某项用途设计的具体器具或装置 an electronic device; a safety device This device measures temperature. 这个装置测量温度。 核心区别与用法 gear 泛指某项活动所需装备，偏日常；equipment 是不可数的设备总称；device 是可数的具体装置。 camping gear / medical equipment / an electronic device 露营装备／医疗设备／电子装置 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 装备总称 gear/equipment 通常不可数；一件具体装置用 a device。不能说 an equipment，可说 a piece of equipment。gear 的齿轮义则可数。

fields.正文: 62 dangle / hang dangle ▷ 朗读 To hang loosely, often swinging back and forth. hang ▷ 朗读 To be supported from above, or attach something so it is supported from above. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 dangle / hang · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 dangle v. 悬垂；悬着晃动 从一端松松挂下，常有摆动感 dangle from; dangle sth over A key dangled from the chain. 钥匙悬在链子上晃动。 hang v. 悬挂 通用的挂起或垂下，不必晃动 hang on; hang from Hang your coat on the hook. 把外套挂在钩子上。 核心区别与用法 hang 泛指悬挂；dangle 强调松松垂下，常带有晃动感。悬挂义 hang 的过去式为 hung。 A key dangled from the chain. 一把钥匙悬在链子上晃动。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 想表达松垂晃动用 dangle，一般悬挂用 hang。悬挂义过去式通常是 hung；hanged 通常用于绞刑义，不能作为所有语境的过去式。

fields.正文: 63 staff / personnel staff ▷ 朗读 The people employed by an organization; to provide workers for it. personnel ▷ 朗读 The people working for an organization; also matters involving employees. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 staff / personnel · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 staff n./v. 员工总称；配备人员 强调一个组织的工作团队 a staff member; teaching staff The staff are very helpful. 员工们很乐于助人。 personnel n. 人员；人事 较正式，常用于行政、人事或军事场景 military personnel; personnel records Only authorized personnel may enter. 只有获授权人员可以进入。 核心区别与用法 staff 指某组织全体员工，日常常用；personnel 较正式，常用于人事、行政或军队。都不能按普通可数名词随意说 a staff/a personnel 来指一名员工。 a staff member / military personnel 一名员工／军事人员 常用搭配与句型 teaching staff 教职人员；staff members 员工；personnel department 人事部门；be short-staffed 人手不足。 易错提醒 staff 作动词可表示为某处配备员工：staff a reception desk。a staff 在“一个员工团队”等语境中可以成立，但不是“一名员工”。 The centre is staffed by volunteers. 这个中心由志愿者配备工作人员。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 一名员工说 a staff member 或 a member of staff，不说 a personnel。staff 指整体时单复数谓语用法与英美习惯和集体/成员视角有关。

fields.正文: 64 develop / advance develop ▷ 朗读 To grow, improve, or bring something into being over time. advance ▷ 朗读 To move forward, make progress, or put forward an idea. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 develop / advance · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 develop v. 发展；培养；开发 逐步形成能力、产品、状态，也可指患病 develop a skill; develop a product She developed an interest in art. 她逐渐对艺术产生兴趣。 advance v./n. 前进；推进；进展；提出；提前 往前推动、提出观点，也可表示提前 advance a theory; in advance The researchers advanced a new theory. 研究人员提出了一种新理论。 核心区别与用法 develop 强调发展、形成或开发；advance 强调向前推进、进步，也有提前等义。 develop a skill / advance a theory 培养技能／提出一种理论 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 强调形成或培养用 develop；强调推进或进步用 advance。advance a theory 是提出理论，不一定表示这套理论已经被证实。

fields.正文: 65 evidence / proof evidence ▷ 朗读 Facts or information that help show whether something is true. proof ▷ 朗读 Evidence or reasoning sufficient to establish that something is true. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 evidence / proof · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 evidence n. 证据（通常不可数） 支持某判断的信息，力度可强可弱 evidence of/for; a piece of evidence There is evidence of recent activity. 有近期活动的迹象。 proof n. 证明；确证 一般指足以使人信服的证据，也指数学证明 proof of; a mathematical proof This is not proof of success. 这不能证明已经成功。 核心区别与用法 evidence 是支持判断的证据或线索，不一定足以定论；proof 在一般语境中指足以证明的证据，数学中指严格证明。两词法律用法需看具体语境。 There is evidence, but no conclusive proof. 有证据，但没有确凿证明。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ evidence 支持某个判断，但力度不一；proof 通常更有足以确证的意味。evidence 通常不可数，数学中的一个证明则可说 a proof。

fields.英文释义: A doctor trained to perform operations.

fields.正文: 66 surgeon / physician surgeon ▷ 朗读 A doctor trained to perform operations. physician ▷ 朗读 A medical doctor, especially one who treats illnesses without surgery. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 surgeon / physician · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 surgeon n. 外科医生 以手术治疗为专业方向 a heart surgeon; a dental surgeon The surgeon performed the operation. 外科医生实施了手术。 physician n. 医生；内科医生 美式可泛指医生；与 surgeon 对照时常指内科医生 a family physician; consult a physician She works as a family physician. 她是一名家庭医生。 核心区别与用法 surgeon 指外科医生；physician 泛指医生时常见于美式英语，也可特指内科医生。原拼写 pysicion 应为 physician。 a heart surgeon / a family physician 心脏外科医生／家庭医生 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 外科手术专业用 surgeon；physician 的范围随地区与语境变化。与 surgeon 对举时常侧重内科，不能在所有英语地区都简单译成内科医生。

fields.正文: 67 capable / competent capable ▷ 朗读 Having the ability or potential to do something. competent ▷ 朗读 Having sufficient skill or knowledge to do something properly. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 capable / competent · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 capable adj. 有能力的 强调具有做成某事的能力或潜力 capable of doing; a capable leader He is capable of solving it. 他有能力解决它。 competent adj. 能胜任的 技能达到完成任务所需水平 competent at/in; competent to do She is competent at her job. 她能胜任自己的工作。 核心区别与用法 capable 强调有能力或潜力，常用 capable of doing；competent 强调达到所需标准、能胜任，常用 competent at/in。二者均可作褒义。 She is capable of leading the team. / a competent manager 她有能力带队。／一位称职的经理 常用搭配与句型 be capable of doing 有能力做；a capable assistant 能干的助理；be competent to do 有能力胜任；be competent in a field 胜任某领域工作。 易错提醒 capable of 后接名词或动名词，不接 to do。competent 不必暗示卓越，但也不是贬义的“勉强能做”。 She is capable of learning quickly and is already competent at the job. 她有快速学习的能力，而且已经能够胜任这份工作。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ capable of 后接名词或动名词；competent at/in 常接领域或活动，competent to do 也可用。competent 表示胜任，不必贬低成“只是勉强合格”。

fields.释义: adj. 新出现的；正在形成的

fields.正文: 68 emergent / pressing emergent ▷ 朗读 Newly appearing or beginning to develop. pressing ▷ 朗读 Urgent and needing attention soon. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 emergent / pressing · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 emergent adj. 新出现的；正在形成的 常指发展过程中涌现的事物或性质 emergent technology; emergent properties The team studies emergent patterns. 团队研究新出现的模式。 pressing adj. 紧迫的 需要尽快处理，强调迫切性 a pressing need; a pressing problem Housing is a pressing issue. 住房是一个紧迫问题。 核心区别与用法 emergent 常指新出现、正在形成的，某些专业语境可指紧急的；pressing 指迫切需处理的。不能一般性地把 emergent 等同于 urgent。 emergent technology / a pressing problem 新兴技术／迫切的问题 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 谈新涌现的现象用 emergent；谈必须尽快处理的问题用 pressing。emergent 在特定专业语境能有紧急义，但日常不能普遍替代 urgent。

fields.英文释义: To a very high degree.

fields.正文: 69 drastically / extremely drastically ▷ 朗读 To a great extent, especially when describing a major change. extremely ▷ 朗读 To a very high degree. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 drastically / extremely · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 drastically adv. 大幅度地；剧烈地 修饰变化、减少或行动，强调幅度很大 change drastically; reduce drastically The rules changed drastically. 规则发生了大幅变化。 extremely adv. 极其 修饰可分程度的形容词或副词 extremely useful; extremely slowly The instructions are extremely clear. 说明极其清楚。 核心区别与用法 drastically 强调变化或措施幅度大，常修饰 change/reduce；extremely 是程度副词，常修饰形容词、副词。 Costs fell drastically. / It is extremely expensive. 成本大幅下降。／它极其昂贵。 常用搭配与句型 change drastically 发生剧变；reduce drastically 大幅减少；extremely useful 极有用；extremely slowly 极其缓慢。 易错提醒 drastically 主要说明变化、削减或措施的幅度；extremely 主要提高形容词或副词的程度。描述“非常高兴”用 extremely happy。 The plan changed drastically, making the task extremely difficult. 计划发生了很大变化，使任务变得极其困难。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 变化、降低的幅度大常用 drastically；形容词或副词程度很高常用 extremely。extremely happy 很自然，drastically happy 则不是相应常用表达。

fields.正文: 72 complicate / complicated / complex complicate ▷ 朗读 To make something harder to understand or deal with. complicated ▷ 朗读 Having details or difficulties that make something hard to understand. complex ▷ 朗读 Having many connected parts; also a group of related buildings or facilities. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 complicate / complicated / complex · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 complicate v. 使复杂 动作：增加问题的难度或复杂程度 complicate matters; complicate a task Don't complicate matters. 别把事情弄复杂。 complicated adj. 复杂难懂的 常强调细节多、难以理解或处理 a complicated procedure The instructions are complicated. 说明很复杂难懂。 complex adj./n. 复杂的；综合体 常强调多个部分相互关联，不必带负面评价 a complex system; a building complex The brain is a complex system. 大脑是一个复杂系统。 核心区别与用法 complicate 是动词“使复杂”；complicated 常强调繁杂、难理解；complex 常强调多个部分相互关联。后两者大量重叠，并非一个必贬一个必中性。 Don't complicate a complex problem. 别把一个复杂问题弄得更繁杂。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ complicate 是动作；complicated/complex 是描述性质。后两词有大量重叠，不是“贬义”和“中性”的绝对对立；不要说 It is complicate。

fields.正文: 73 compliment / complement / praise / flatter / admire / appreciate compliment ▷ 朗读 An expression of admiration or approval; to give one. complement ▷ 朗读 Something that completes or improves another thing; to combine well with it. praise ▷ 朗读 To express approval or admiration; words of approval. flatter ▷ 朗读 To praise someone, often excessively, or make them look more attractive. admire ▷ 朗读 To respect someone or look at something with pleasure. appreciate ▷ 朗读 To recognize value, feel grateful, or understand a situation fully. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 compliment / complement / praise / flatter / admire / appreciate · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 compliment n./v. 称赞 通常是针对外貌、表现等的具体赞美 compliment sb on; pay a compliment He complimented me on my presentation. 他称赞了我的演讲。 complement n./v. 补充；相得益彰 让另一事物更完整或更协调，不是夸奖 complement each other; a complement to Their skills complement each other. 他们的技能互补。 praise n./v. 赞扬 对表现、品质或成就表达肯定，范围较广 praise sb for; high praise The teacher praised her effort. 老师表扬了她的努力。 flatter v. 奉承；使显得好看 可能为取悦别人而过度夸赞；也可指衣着衬人 flatter sb; a flattering colour That colour flatters you. 那个颜色很衬你。 admire v. 钦佩；欣赏 可以是内心赞赏，不一定当面说出 admire sb for; admire the view I admire her courage. 我钦佩她的勇气。 appreciate v. 感激；欣赏；理解价值 强调认可价值、感谢帮助，也可指理解情况 appreciate your help; appreciate that I appreciate your patience. 感谢你的耐心。 核心区别与用法 compliment 指具体称赞，可作名词或动词；complement 指补充、相得益彰；praise 泛指赞扬；flatter 常指奉承；admire 指钦佩；appreciate 指欣赏、感激或理解价值。 I appreciate your help. / She complimented me on my work. 我感谢你的帮助。／她称赞了我的工作。 常用搭配与句型 compliment sb on sth 就某事称赞某人；pay sb a compliment 夸奖某人；admire sb for sth 因某事钦佩某人；appreciate doing 感激／乐于做。 易错提醒 appreciate 常直接接事物或动名词；表示“如果你……我将感激”可说 I would appreciate it if…；complement 的 e 对应“补充”。 The sauce complements the fish. / I appreciate your taking the time to help. 这种酱汁与鱼搭配得很好。／感谢你抽时间帮忙。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 称赞用 compliment/praise，内心钦佩用 admire，感激或认可价值用 appreciate。complement 是补充，不是称赞；flatter 也可指衣服衬人，未必都是奉承。

fields.正文: 74 confront / face confront ▷ 朗读 To deal directly with a difficulty or challenge someone face to face. face ▷ 朗读 To deal with or be presented with something; the front of the head. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 confront / face · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 confront v. 直面；对质 常强调直接处理问题或当面提出争议 confront sb with; be confronted with She confronted him with the evidence. 她拿证据与他对质。 face v./n. 面对；脸 泛指面临或处理，不一定发生正面对质 face a challenge; face up to We face a difficult choice. 我们面临艰难的选择。 核心区别与用法 face 泛指面对，可主动或处于不得不面对的境地；confront 常强调直接处理难题，或当面对质。confront someone with something 是拿某事与某人对质。 We must face the facts. / She confronted him about the lie. 我们必须面对事实。／她就谎言当面质问他。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ face 范围较广，可指被动面临或主动处理；confront 常更有正面处理、对质的力度。confront sb with evidence 是拿证据与某人对质。

fields.正文: 75 suppose / speculate suppose ▷ 朗读 To think something is likely or assume something for discussion. speculate ▷ 朗读 To form ideas without enough evidence, or invest for uncertain profit. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 suppose / speculate · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 suppose v. 认为；假设 常见于日常推想，或引出假设情况 suppose that; be supposed to I suppose he's busy. 我想他在忙。 speculate v. 推测；投机 根据有限证据猜测，也可指金融投机 speculate about/on; speculate that We speculated about the cause. 我们推测了原因。 核心区别与用法 suppose 常指认为、假设；speculate 强调在证据不充分时推测，常用 speculate about/on 或 speculate that。按你后来的更正，保留 suppose。 I suppose he's busy. / They speculated about the cause. 我想他在忙。／他们推测原因。 常用搭配与句型 suppose that 认为／假设；be supposed to do 应该做或按安排做；speculate about/on 推测；speculate in stocks 投机炒股。 易错提醒 I suppose 表示带不确定性的看法；Suppose we miss the train 是引出假设。be supposed to 并非每次都翻译成“被猜测”。 You are supposed to arrive at nine. / We can only speculate about the outcome. 你应该九点到达。／我们只能推测结果。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 日常推想常用 suppose；证据不足而推测常用 speculate。be supposed to do 常表示应该或按安排做，与 speculate 的猜测义不能直接互换。

fields.正文: 76 prejudice / discriminate prejudice ▷ 朗读 An unfair judgment made without sufficient knowledge; to bias or harm. discriminate ▷ 朗读 To treat people unfairly based on group identity, or recognize differences. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 prejudice / discriminate · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 prejudice n./v. 偏见；使有偏见；损害 常指未充分了解便形成的态度，也可作动词 prejudice against; prejudiced views Prejudice can influence judgment. 偏见会影响判断。 discriminate v. 歧视；辨别 歧视义指区别对待；辨别义可为中性 discriminate against; discriminate between They discriminated against older applicants. 他们歧视年龄较大的申请人。 核心区别与用法 prejudice 常作名词，指预先形成的偏见，也可作动词“使有偏见”；discriminate 是动词，既可指辨别，也可指歧视，后者常用 discriminate against。 Prejudice can lead people to discriminate against others. 偏见可能使人歧视他人。 常用搭配与句型 prejudice against 对……的偏见；be prejudiced against 对……抱有偏见；discriminate against 歧视；discriminate between 辨别；discrimination 歧视／辨别。 易错提醒 做平行比较时，可比较名词 prejudice 与 discrimination：前者侧重态度，后者在歧视义上侧重区别对待。discriminate 的辨别义不一定带负面评价。 Children learn to discriminate between similar sounds. 孩子逐渐学会辨别相似的声音。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 这组原词词性不平行：prejudice 常是名词，discriminate 是动词。若比较两个名词，应用 prejudice 与 discrimination；前者偏态度，后者歧视义偏行为。

fields.正文: 77 clip / bump clip ▷ 朗读 A fastener or short extract; to fasten, cut, or hit something briefly, often at an edge. bump ▷ 朗读 A small raised area or a light collision; to hit something accidentally. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 clip / bump · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 clip n./v. 夹子；短片；夹住；剪；击打或擦撞 除夹、剪外，也可指快速击打或擦撞物体边缘；与 bump 的碰撞义有交叉 a video clip; clip sth to; clip a wing; clip the kerb The car clipped the kerb as it turned. 汽车转弯时擦撞了路缘。 bump n./v. 碰撞；凸起 常指不太猛烈的撞击或表面不平 bump into; a bump in the road I bumped into the table. 我撞到了桌子。 核心区别与用法 比较碰撞义时，clip 常指短促击打或擦撞边缘，如 The car clipped the kerb；bump 指碰到、撞上，常但不一定力度较轻，如 I bumped into the table。clip 并不一定是故意动作；bump 也不一定只限于意外。bump into someone 还可表示偶遇。clip 的夹子、短片、夹住和剪等义需另按语境理解。 Clip the badge to your shirt. → 把徽章夹在衬衫上。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 比较碰撞义时，clip 常指短促击打或擦撞边缘，如 The car clipped the kerb；bump 指碰到、撞上，常但不一定力度较轻，如 I bumped into the table。clip 并不一定是故意动作；bump 也不一定只限于意外。bump into someone 还可表示偶遇。clip 的夹子、短片、夹住和剪等义需另按语境理解。

fields.正文: 79 span / range span ▷ 朗读 The distance or time between two limits; to extend across them. range ▷ 朗读 The limits, variety, or extent of something; to vary between limits. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 span / range · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 span n./v. 跨度；横跨；持续 强调两端之间的长度或持续时间 attention span; span decades Her career spanned four decades. 她的职业生涯长达四十年。 range n./v. 范围；系列；变化 强调上下限、覆盖范围或可选种类 a range of; range from A to B The shop sells a wide range of books. 这家店出售种类繁多的书。 核心区别与用法 span 侧重从起点到终点跨越的长度或时间；range 侧重上下限之间的范围，或可选择的种类。动词 span 表示横跨、持续，range 表示在某范围内变化。 常用搭配与句型 a time span of ten years 十年时间跨度；attention span 注意力持续时间；a wide range of choices 广泛的选择；range from A to B 从 A 到 B 不等 易错提醒 跨度可以是一个测量值，范围则常有上下界。age range 18–25 是年龄范围；a span of seven years 是七年跨度。 His career spanned forty years. / Prices range from £10 to £50. 他的职业生涯长达四十年。／价格从10英镑到50英镑不等。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ span 常看两端跨度，range 常看上下限或种类。a price range 指价格范围，a time span 指时间跨度；两者有交叉但搭配不同。

fields.例句: The decision was made by ballot.
fields.例句译文: 这项决定是投票作出的。

fields.英文释义: A formal expression of choice; to express that choice in a decision.

fields.正文: 80 ballot / vote ballot ▷ 朗读 A voting paper or a voting process, usually secret; to hold a vote. vote ▷ 朗读 A formal expression of choice; to express that choice in a decision. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 ballot / vote · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 ballot n./v. 选票；投票；进行投票 常强调正式表决的方式、程序或一轮投票 a secret ballot; ballot paper The decision was made by ballot. 这项决定是投票作出的。 vote n./v. 票；投票 可以指行为、票数、表决或投票权 vote for/against; cast a vote I voted against the proposal. 我投票反对该提案。 核心区别与用法 vote 是“投票”这一行为、投出的票或票数，也可作动词；ballot 可指选票，也可指一轮投票或投票制度，尤其强调正式投票程序。 常用搭配与句型 vote for/against a proposal 赞成／反对提案；cast a vote 投票；a ballot paper 选票；a secret ballot 无记名投票 易错提醒 ballot 不总是纸质选票；by ballot 表示以投票方式。win by 100 votes 中的票数通常用 votes。 Members voted by secret ballot. / She received 200 votes. 成员通过无记名投票表决。／她获得200票。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ vote 既可指投票行为也可数票；ballot 常突出选票或投票程序。by secret ballot 表示无记名投票，不意味着只能使用纸张。

fields.英文释义: An aim or intention; as an adjective, focused or firmly determined.

fields.正文: 81 intent / intention / purpose intent ▷ 朗读 An aim or intention; as an adjective, focused or firmly determined. intention ▷ 朗读 Something you plan or mean to do. purpose ▷ 朗读 The reason something is done or the use it is designed for. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 intent / intention / purpose · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 intent n./adj. 意图；专注的 名词较正式；形容词表示一心投入 with intent; intent on doing She is intent on finishing today. 她一心要今天完成。 intention n. 意图；打算 常用于某人计划做或不做某事 intention of doing; have no intention of I have no intention of leaving. 我没有离开的打算。 purpose n. 目的；用途 回答为什么做、用来干什么或有什么意义 the purpose of; on purpose What is the purpose of this button? 这个按钮有什么用途？ 核心区别与用法 intention 常指打算做某事的意图；intent 也指意图，较正式，尤其用于法律或强调决心的语境；purpose 侧重行为希望达到的目的、用途或意义。 常用搭配与句型 have no intention of doing 无意做；with the intention of doing 为了做；with intent 故意地；the purpose of sth 某事的目的；on purpose 故意地 易错提醒 intent 也作形容词：be intent on doing 一心要做。不要把 intention 后的 of doing 写成 of to do。purpose 还能表示物品用途。 I had no intention of offending you. / The purpose of the meeting is to solve the problem. 我无意冒犯你。／会议的目的是解决这个问题。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 打算做什么常用 intention；更正式的意图常用 intent；为什么做或某物有何用途用 purpose。intent on 中 on 是介词，后接名词或动名词。 intent 与 intention 的名词义大幅重叠；不能把 intent 固定解释为动机、intention 固定解释为计划。motive 更直接回答促使行动的原因，而 intent 常说明意图实现什么。

fields.释义: n./v./adj. 山峰；峰值；达到顶峰的
fields.英文释义: A mountain top or highest level; to reach the highest point.
fields.搭配: at its peak; peak at; peak demand

fields.正文: 82 summit / peak summit ▷ 朗读 The top of a mountain or a meeting of leaders. peak ▷ 朗读 A mountain top or highest level; to reach the highest point. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 summit / peak · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 summit n. 山顶；峰会 山的最高点，或领导人的高级别会议 reach the summit; a peace summit The leaders attended a summit. 领导人出席了一场峰会。 peak n./v./adj. 山峰；峰值；达到顶峰的 实体峰顶或抽象数值、水平的最高点 at its peak; peak at; peak demand Sales peaked in June. 销量在六月达到峰值。 核心区别与用法 summit 常指山的最高点，也指国家领导人的峰会；peak 指尖峰、峰值或最高水平，适用于山峰、需求、成绩等。二者在山顶义上可重叠。 常用搭配与句型 reach the summit 登顶；a climate summit 气候峰会；peak demand 需求高峰；at its peak 处于巅峰；peak at 达到峰值 易错提醒 peak 可作动词和形容词：Sales peaked in July；peak hours。summit 不用于普通的“用电峰值”。 They reached the summit at dawn. / Demand peaks in summer. 他们在黎明时登顶。／需求在夏季达到高峰。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 山顶义 summit/peak 可重叠；领导人峰会用 summit；需求或销量峰值用 peak。peak 可作动词：Sales peaked，summit 通常不这样表达数值达到峰值。

fields.英文释义: To fail to give necessary care or attention; such a failure.
fields.搭配: neglect duties; neglect to do
fields.例句: The garden suffered from neglect.
fields.例句译文: 花园因疏于照料而荒废。

fields.英文释义: An accidental omission or mistake; also supervision.

fields.正文: 83 neglect / oversight neglect ▷ 朗读 To fail to give necessary care or attention; such a failure. oversight ▷ 朗读 An accidental omission or mistake; also supervision. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 neglect / oversight · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 neglect v./n. 疏于照顾；忽视 未给予应有的注意或照顾，可长期也可一次 neglect duties; neglect to do The garden suffered from neglect. 花园因疏于照料而荒废。 oversight n. 疏漏；监督 an oversight 指无意遗漏；监督义通常不可数 through an oversight; regulatory oversight The error was an oversight. 这个错误是一时疏漏。 核心区别与用法 neglect 指没有给予应有的照顾或注意，可指长期疏于照料，也可指漏做某事；oversight 作可数名词常指无意的疏漏，另有不可数的“监督”义。 常用搭配与句型 neglect one's duties 玩忽职责；neglect to do 忘记或疏于做；due to an oversight 由于疏忽；government oversight 政府监督 易错提醒 neglect 不必然是故意的；oversight 的“疏漏”和“监督”两义要靠上下文判断。an oversight 是一个疏漏。 I neglected to reply. / Her name was omitted through an oversight. 我疏忽了，没有回复。／她的名字因疏忽而被漏掉了。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ neglect 可为未照料、未注意或未尽责，不一定故意；an oversight 常是无意遗漏。监督义 oversight 通常不可数，需结合 government/regulatory 等上下文判断。

fields.正文: 84 associate / vice / deputy associate ▷ 朗读 To connect ideas or people; a colleague; sometimes a lower-ranking title. vice ▷ 朗读 In job titles, a prefix indicating a deputy or second-in-command. deputy ▷ 朗读 Someone who assists a leader and can act in their place. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 associate / vice / deputy · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 associate adj./n./v. 副职的；同事；联系 职称表示专业级别或关联身份，不能统一排职级 associate professor; associate A with B She is an associate professor. 她是一位副教授。 vice 职称构词成分 vice-：副 常出现在副职称中；单独名词 vice 另有恶习等义 vice-president; vice-chair The vice-president gave a speech. 副主席作了讲话。 deputy n./adj. 副手；代理的 强调协助负责人，或获授权代行职责 deputy manager; deputy head The deputy manager is in charge today. 今天由副经理负责。 核心区别与用法 这些词用于职称时不能只按中文“副”互换。associate 常表示某个专业职级或关联身份；vice- 构成副职称；deputy 常强调副手或获授权代行职责者。 常用搭配与句型 associate professor 副教授；associate director 副主任；vice-president 副总裁／副主席；deputy manager 副经理 易错提醒 具体职级由机构决定，不存在普遍适用的高低排序。associate 还可作动词：associate A with B，把A与B联系起来。 She is an associate professor. / The deputy director chaired the meeting. 她是一位副教授。／副主任主持了会议。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ 职称按具体机构正式名称理解，associate、vice-、deputy 不能排成普遍通用的职级高低表。associate 还可作联系的动词，vice 单独作名词常是恶习。

fields.正文: 85 mix / blend mix ▷ 朗读 To combine things, which may remain distinguishable; a combination. blend ▷ 朗读 To combine smoothly into a unified mixture. 逐词对比 手机可左右滑动表格，横向比较用法与例句。 mix / blend · 用法对照 单词 / 表达 词性、含义与侧重点 常见搭配 / 句型 中英例句 mix v./n. 混合；混合物 把不同东西放在一起，不要求完全融合 mix A with B; mix up Mix the flour with water. 把面粉和水混合。 blend v./n. 融合；混合物 常强调均匀、协调、不容易分辨各部分 blend into; a blend of Her voice blended with the music. 她的声音与音乐融为一体。 核心区别与用法 mix 泛指把不同东西放在一起混合，结果未必均匀；blend 常强调融合得均匀、协调，原来的部分不那么容易区分。两者在食物等语境可以重叠。 常用搭配与句型 mix A with B 把A与B混合；mix up 混淆／弄乱；blend into the background 融入背景；a blend of styles 多种风格的融合 易错提醒 blend 不一定是液体，也可描述声音、色彩、风格。mix up names 是弄混名字，不是把名字融合。 Mix the flour with water. / The colours blend beautifully. 把面粉与水混合。／这些颜色融合得很漂亮。 怎么选？易错点在哪？ mix 只是混合，blend 常暗示协调或均匀；两者在食物语境有重叠。mix up names 是混淆名字，blend into the crowd 是融入人群。
